CheckTitle: Ensure the S3 bucket CloudTrail logs to is not publicly accessible
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that the S3 bucket receiving CloudTrail logs is not publicly accessible.
Risk: Public CloudTrail buckets leak a complete record of account activity and infrastructure to attackers, and may allow log tampering.

Recommendation.Text: Enable Block Public Access on the CloudTrail bucket and remove public ACL grants and policy statements.

Notes: CIS AWS 1.x/2.0 control 3.3, removed from the 3.0 numbering; mapped to 2.1.4 (S3 Block Public Access).
